families.definition: An explicit current action names its object and constraint.
families.boundary: Exclude quote-only or historical action when it is not the current requested goal.

families.definition: A present difficulty or limitation motivates a separately recoverable current goal.
families.boundary: Do not label the difficulty background as a second requested target.

families.definition: A need or missing capability conveys the present task without a standard request verb.
families.boundary: Distinguish a request from a report that lacks sufficient evidence for a topic.

families.definition: The desired completion condition precedes the action or object needed to reach it.
families.boundary: Do not infer a target from an unrelated desirable outcome alone.

families.definition: The current goal compares alternatives under a stated criterion.
families.boundary: Alternatives are competing solutions,not automatically simultaneous topic labels.

families.definition: A correction replaces an earlier stated target while retaining relevant factual context.
families.boundary: The superseded target cannot remain a current positive solely from word occurrence.

families.definition: Quoted,hypothetical or past material is explicitly the object of a current meta-task.
families.boundary: Quote ownership and current request must be resolved;not every past/hypothetical text is DEFER.

families.definition: A current goal is expressed with an instrumental action and scoped exclusion.
families.boundary: Keep means/background distinct from goal;negation alone is not a DEFER rule.

families.definition: A legitimate continuation has an object recoverable from relevant title/recent context.
families.boundary: Expired/irrelevant/missing referents cannot be supplied from arbitrary context.

families.definition: A natural incomplete utterance provides sufficient action/object/goal jointly across evidence spans.
families.boundary: Missing decisive object/goal or competing interpretation remains ambiguity control.

source_policy: Fresh original base scenarios,not translations/synonym substitutions or copied v04 inputs/errors;scenario/template/contrast closures kept together. Existing frozen data,journals,tags,intake revisions and competition spending remain unchanged. Rotated family names are authoring hypotheses,not proof of semantic holdout or independent scenarios.

first_batch_selection.policy: Pinned Catalog first Topic per domain,not candidate errors;coherent source intake with full144 output denominator and explicit missing classes
